passive.name: Crimson Pact
passive.description: Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power and every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health (does not stack with itself).

primaryAbilities.name: Transfusion
primaryAbilities.description: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Vladimir drains his target's lifeforce, dealing {{ basedamagetooltip }} magic damage and restoring {{ basehealtooltip }} Health. After using this Ability twice, Vladimir gains {{ movementspeedonq2 }}% Move Speed for 0.5 seconds and empowers the next use of this Ability for {{ frenzyduration }} seconds.

The empowered version of this Ability deals {{ empowereddamagetooltip }} magic damage instead and restores an additional {{ empoweredhealtooltip }} plus {{ empoweredhealpercenttooltip }} missing Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Sanguine Pool
primaryAbilities.description: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood for 2 seconds, gaining {{ hasteboost*100 }}% decaying Move Speed for {{ hasteduration }} second and becoming Untargetable and Ghosted while Slowing enemies in the pool by {{ movespeedmod*-100 }}%.

Vladimir deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and restores {{ totalheal }} Health per enemy over the duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Tides of Blood
primaryAbilities.description: Vladimir pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood which, when released, deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Begin Charging: Vladimir charges up a reservoir of blood, spending up to {{ chargehealthtooltip }} Health. While at full charge, Vladimir is Slowed by 20%.

Release: Vladimir unleashes a torrent of blood missiles at surrounding enemies, dealing between {{ mindamagetooltip }} and {{ maxdamagetooltip }} magic damage based on charge time. If this Ability was charged for at least 1 second, it also Slows targets by {{ slowpercent }}% for 0.5 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
primaryAbilities.resourceTemplate: Channeling Cost {{ maxhealthcost }}% of max Health ({{ chargehealthtooltip }})

primaryAbilities.name: Hemoplague
primaryAbilities.description: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Vladimir creates a virulent plague, causing its victims to take {{ damageamp }}% increased damage from all sources for {{ duration }} seconds. After it expires, Vladimir deals <magicDamage>{{ damage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to all infected targets. Vladimir restores <healing>{{ damage }} Health</healing> if he hits a champion, and restores an additional <healing>{{ secondaryhealingtooltip }} Health</healing> for each champion beyond the first.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
